title: Full-Spectrum Review Audit Index
description: Machine-readable source of truth for <workspace>/fsr-reports/<target>/INDEX.json. INDEX.md is rendered from it for human reading; never hand-maintain the markdown alone.

firstSeen.description: Date or revision when the root cause was first recorded, e.g. 2026-09-04.

latestAudit.description: Pointer to the latest report covering this ID, e.g. a report filename.
